title: alsophila hooglandii
intro: Alsophila hooglandii, commonly known as the Papuan tree fern, is a species of plant in the family Cyathea. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, pain, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Alsophila hooglandii include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties, which contribute to its use in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
